versions.description: Community Fund — players contribute currency toward a shared goal. When the threshold is reached the fund resets and completion commands fire.

commands.name: fund-contribute
commands.description: Contribute currency to the community fund
commands.helpText: Contribute currency to the community fund. Amount must be a positive whole number.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.helpText: The amount of currency to contribute

commands.name: fund-history
commands.description: View the community fund completion history

commands.description: Check the current community fund status
